gaps.s: The clef whose middle line is middle C is the ___ clef.
The key with two sharps is ___ major.
C up to G is a perfect ___.
An ornament that is a quick crushed note is an ___.
A scale of five notes is called ___.
A horn in F sounds a perfect ___ lower than written.
The relative minor of C major is A ___.
A pitch halfway between two semitones is a ___-tone.

short.q: Name the interval from D up to F and explain how you know.
short.model: A minor 3rd: D to F is three letters and 3 semitones, because D major has F♯.
points: reason (3 semitones / F♯ in D major)

short.q: How can you tell a piece is in a minor key from a printed score?
short.model: The final note and chords fit the relative minor and an accidental raises the 7th degree.

short.q: A clarinet in A is written E. What is the concert pitch?
short.model: C♯, a minor 3rd lower than written.

short.q: Describe a melody that is scalic.
short.model: It moves by step along the notes of a scale, ascending or descending.

short.q: Give two ways to describe the range of a melody.
short.model: Narrow (small distance between lowest and highest note) or wide (large distance).
